item.title: Pop Mart Twinkle Twinkle
item.description: Pop Mart’s Twinkle Twinkle plush pendants: reported minute-long sell-outs and resale above retail in China, and a US series that launched on 1 October 2026. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early in the West.
